# Our Family Socials: a private family social network
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/

Never miss your family's greatest adventures. Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network for families to share life events, photos and stories with each other instead of posting them publicly. See where they have been, relive the moments, and stay connected across any distance.

## Stay connected across any distance
From weekend getaways to once-in-a-lifetime trips, keep up with what your family is doing. Follow the relatives you care about, see their events in the order they happened, and stop finding out about a graduation three weeks after the fact.

## Your memories are yours
No ads. No data selling. No algorithms. A family-sized space instead of a public one.
- Not public by default - a new event goes to the followers you have approved, not to the open internet, and you can narrow or widen that audience for every event.
- No ads, ever - we will never sell your data or show ads. Your memories are not a product.
- Built for families - made by a family, for families.

## Who can see an event
You choose an audience for every event you create: Followers (the default), Close Family, a custom group, Private (only you) or Public. Public events can be opened by anyone who has the link, including people without an account, so choose a narrower audience for anything you want kept inside the family.
One thing worth knowing: signed-in members can see an event in the shared feed unless you set it to Private, and opening the event page itself is then gated by the audience you chose. People who are not signed in only ever see events set to Public.

## What you can do
- Follow family members - see what your family is up to in a chronological feed, with no algorithm hiding posts. Never miss a birthday party, graduation, vacation or Sunday dinner.
- Rich event pages - photo galleries with lightbox viewing, rich text for the full story, comments and likes from family, and every detail that makes a trip worth remembering.
- Interactive maps and timeline - see every trip on an interactive world map, follow multi-location journey maps, and browse a timeline organised by year. Filter by person, place or date.
- GPS extraction from photos - Our Family Socials reads the location data already stored in your photos and suggests the places you visited.
- Video support - add video clips alongside photos, with a built-in trimmer.
- AI Create (beta) - upload a batch of photos and AI groups them, asks a few questions and drafts the story for you to edit. Available on a paid plan or during the free trial.
- Family trees - a visual family tree built from relationships both people have confirmed.
- Tag profiles - tag children, older relatives or pets who do not have an account yet; they can claim the profile later.
- Audience controls - choose who sees each event, from Public down to a custom group such as "close family only" or Private, just for you.

## How it works
1. Create an account at ourfamilysocials.com. Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial, no credit card required, and you can publish up to 5 events during it.
2. Follow your family. Send follow requests or email invitations. Once someone accepts, you see each other's events.
3. Share life events. Build an event page with photos, a story, dates and locations, then choose its audience.
4. Stay connected. Browse the feed, the map or the timeline, and comment and like just like a normal social network - only among family rather than in public.

## Common questions
Q: What is Our Family Socials?
A: Our Family Socials is a private social network designed for families. It lets you share life events, photos, and stories with your closest family members and friends. Unlike public social media, a new event goes to the family you have approved rather than to the open internet, and there are no ads or algorithms.

Q: Is it really free?
A: Viewing is free forever: the free plan includes viewing the events you have access to, following family members, commenting and liking. Creating events needs an active trial or subscription. Every new account gets a 30-day Pro trial during which you can publish up to 5 events; after that you need Pro or Lifetime to publish, and those plans remove the 5-event limit.

Q: Who can see my events?
A: You choose an audience for every event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a custom group, Private (only you) or Public. Follow requests are yours to accept or decline. Two things are worth knowing: an event set to Public can be opened by anyone who has the link, including people without an account; and any event that is not set to Private can appear in the shared feed to signed-in members, although opening the event page itself is still gated by the audience you chose.

Q: Can I share an event with someone who doesn't have an account?
A: Yes! Each event can be shared via a private link. Recipients can view that specific event without needing an account, but they won't see your other events or be able to follow you.
Read all the answers on the FAQ page.

## Simple, transparent pricing
Start for free. Upgrade when you need more.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial and no credit card is required. During the trial you can publish up to 5 events - only published events count, so drafts and deleted events are free. Pro and Lifetime remove the 5-event limit. If the trial ends and you have not subscribed you keep a free account for viewing, liking and commenting, but you cannot create new events until you subscribe.
- Free to View - $0/forever. View the events you have access to, like and comment, follow family members, interactive maps and timeline, and a 30-day Pro trial with up to 5 published events.
- Pro - $9/month billed annually ($108/year), or $12/month billed monthly. Create unlimited events, photo and video uploads, journey mapping, GPS extraction from photos, privacy controls and a rich text editor.
- Lifetime - $294 once. Everything in Pro, no recurring fees, all future updates, priority support and early access to features.
30-day free trial on all accounts. Subscribe within 5 days for an extra month free.
After the trial you can still browse the feed, and you can still open your own events, any event set to Public, and events from the people you follow. Opening anything else needs an active trial or subscription.

# Our Family Socials features
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/features

Our Family Socials is a private family social network, and these are the features it ships with today. Everything below is live in the product; anything still being built is marked as such.

## A private, chronological family feed
Follow the family members and close friends you care about. Their events appear in a feed ordered by time, not by an engagement algorithm, so a quiet post about a grandparent's birthday is just as visible as a three-week holiday. Following is request-based: every follow request is yours to accept or decline.
- Chronological feed with no algorithmic ranking
- Follow requests you accept or decline
- Likes and comments from the people you have approved
- Notifications for major life events
- Email invitations so you can bring relatives in directly

## Rich event pages instead of single posts
The core unit in Our Family Socials is an event, not a post. An event is a trip, a birthday, a graduation or a Sunday dinner, with everything that belongs to it in one place.
- Photo galleries with full-screen lightbox viewing
- A rich text editor for the story behind the photos
- Video clips, with a built-in trimmer before upload
- Multiple locations per event, for road trips and multi-stop holidays
- Dates, categories and tagged family members
- Drafts that only you can see, and a trash that holds deleted events for 30 days

## Maps, journeys and timeline
Because every event can carry locations, your family history becomes something you can browse geographically as well as chronologically.
- An interactive world map with a marker for every event you have access to
- Journey maps that connect the stops of a single multi-location trip
- A timeline view grouped by year
- Filters by person, place, category and date
- Automatic GPS extraction from photo metadata, so locations are suggested for you

## AI Create (beta)
AI Create helps with the part most people never get round to: writing the story. You upload a batch of photos, it groups them into a coherent album, asks you a few questions about the trip, and drafts a description you can edit. It is a beta feature, it can make mistakes, and you always review the draft before publishing. AI Create requires an active paid plan or an active free trial.

## Family trees and relationships
You can record how people are actually related - sister, dad, cousin - and both people have to confirm the relationship before it counts. Confirmed relationships build an interactive family tree. For relatives who are not on the platform (young children, older relatives, even pets) you can create a tag profile, tag them in events, and let them claim the profile if they join later.

## Audience and privacy controls
You choose an audience for every event you create: Followers (the default), Close Family, a custom group, Private (only you) or Public. Public events can be opened by anyone who has the link, including people without an account, so choose a narrower audience for anything you want kept inside the family.
- Five audience settings per event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a custom group, Private, or Public
- Public events are readable by anyone with the link, signed in or not - they are the one setting that is not family-only
- Private share links let someone view one specific event without an account, and nothing else
- Follow requests are approved by you, and verified relationships need both people to confirm
- No advertising anywhere in the product, and no selling of your data
One thing worth knowing: signed-in members can see an event in the shared feed unless you set it to Private, and opening the event page itself is then gated by the audience you chose. People who are not signed in only ever see events set to Public.

## Works on the device you already have
Our Family Socials is a progressive web app. It runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers, and on most phones you can add it to your home screen so it opens like a native app. There is no App Store or Google Play download to wait for.

## Coming soon
Printed photo books from an event are advertised on the home page as coming soon. They are not available yet, so do not pick Our Family Socials for printing today.

## What it costs
Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial and no credit card is required. During the trial you can publish up to 5 events - only published events count, so drafts and deleted events are free. Pro and Lifetime remove the 5-event limit. If the trial ends and you have not subscribed you keep a free account for viewing, liking and commenting, but you cannot create new events until you subscribe.
-> Start your free trial: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login

## Pricing questions
Q: How does the free trial work?
A: Sign up and get Pro features for 30 days, with no credit card required. You can publish up to 5 events during the trial. If you subscribe within the first 5 days, you get an extra month free (60 days total).

Q: What happens when my trial ends?
A: After the trial you can still browse the feed, and you can still open your own events, any event set to Public, and events from the people you follow. Opening anything else needs an active trial or subscription. You cannot create new events until you subscribe.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes! Cancel your subscription anytime with no questions asked. You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe, our secure payment partner. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

# Our Family Socials FAQ
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/faq

Frequently asked questions about Our Family Socials, a private social network for families. If your question is not answered here, email support@ourfamilysocials.com.

## Getting Started
Q: What is Our Family Socials?
A: Our Family Socials is a private social network designed for families. It lets you share life events, photos, and stories with your closest family members and friends. Unlike public social media, a new event goes to the family you have approved rather than to the open internet, and there are no ads or algorithms.

Q: Who is Our Family Socials for?
A: It is built for families who want a private place for their memories: parents sharing milestones with grandparents, extended families staying in touch across different countries, and anyone who documents trips and celebrations but does not want to post them on public social media.

Q: Is it really free?
A: Viewing is free forever: the free plan includes viewing the events you have access to, following family members, commenting and liking. Creating events needs an active trial or subscription. Every new account gets a 30-day Pro trial during which you can publish up to 5 events; after that you need Pro or Lifetime to publish, and those plans remove the 5-event limit.

Q: How much does Pro cost?
A: Pro is $9 per month when billed annually ($108 per year) or $12 per month billed monthly. There is also a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account starts with a 30-day free trial of Pro, and no credit card is required to start the trial.

Q: How do I invite my family members?
A: Go to your Profile and you'll find an invite option. You can send email invitations to family members. When they sign up using your invite link, you'll automatically be connected.

Q: Can I use it on my phone?
A: Absolutely! Our Family Socials is fully responsive and works great on phones, tablets, and computers. Just visit ourfamilysocials.com in your mobile browser.

Q: Is there an app I can install?
A: Our Family Socials is a progressive web app (PWA). There is no separate App Store or Google Play download: you open ourfamilysocials.com in your browser and, on most phones, you can add it to your home screen so it opens like a normal app.

## Events & Content
Q: What is an "event"?
A: An event is a collection of photos, stories, and details about something that happened - like a vacation, birthday party, graduation, or Sunday dinner. Think of it as a rich, detailed post that tells the full story of a moment.

Q: How many photos can I add to an event?
A: There is no per-event photo limit on a paid plan or an active trial. Photos are resized before upload - down to 1500 pixels on the longest side and re-encoded as JPEG at 85% quality - and then stored in several sizes for fast loading, so what we keep is a high-quality copy rather than your untouched original file. Keep your originals on your own device or backup. Individual uploads are limited to 10MB, and HEIC photos from iPhones are converted server-side.

Q: Can I add locations to my events?
A: Yes! You can add multiple locations to each event, perfect for road trips and multi-destination adventures. We can also automatically extract GPS data from your photos to suggest locations.

Q: Can I add videos as well as photos?
A: Yes. Pro accounts can upload photos and video clips to an event, and there is a built-in trimmer so you can shorten a clip before uploading it.

Q: What's the difference between Published, Drafts, and Trash?
A: Published events are visible to the audience you chose for them. Drafts are works-in-progress that only you can see. Trash holds deleted events for 30 days before permanent deletion - you can restore them anytime.

Q: Do drafts count toward my event limit?
A: No! Only published events count toward your limit. You can have unlimited drafts and deleted events.

Q: Can AI help me write an event?
A: Yes. AI Create is a beta feature available to accounts on a paid plan or an active free trial. You upload photos and it groups them, asks a few questions, and drafts a story you can edit before publishing. It can make mistakes, so you always review the draft yourself.

## Privacy & Sharing
Q: Who can see my events?
A: You choose an audience for every event: Followers (the default), Close Family, a custom group, Private (only you) or Public. Follow requests are yours to accept or decline. Two things are worth knowing: an event set to Public can be opened by anyone who has the link, including people without an account; and any event that is not set to Private can appear in the shared feed to signed-in members, although opening the event page itself is still gated by the audience you chose.

Q: Can I share an event with someone who doesn't have an account?
A: Yes! Each event can be shared via a private link. Recipients can view that specific event without needing an account, but they won't see your other events or be able to follow you.

Q: Can I make an event public?
A: Yes. Public is one of the five audience settings, and a public event can be opened by anyone who has the link, with or without an account. Our robots.txt asks search engines and AI crawlers not to index event pages, but a public event is not family-only - pick Followers, Close Family, a custom group or Private if that matters.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: Yes. We take privacy seriously. We never sell your data, show ads, or use algorithms to manipulate what you see. Your photos and stories are yours, and we're just here to help you preserve and share them with family.

Q: Does Our Family Socials show ads?
A: No. There is no advertising anywhere in the product and we do not sell your data. The product is paid for by Pro and Lifetime subscriptions, which is why there is a price on the pricing page instead of an ad slot in your feed.

Q: Can I delete my account?
A: Yes. Contact us at support@ourfamilysocials.com and we'll delete your account and all associated data. You can also export your data before deletion.

## Following & Relationships
Q: How do I follow someone?
A: Search for them by username or find them through your existing connections. Send a follow request, and once they accept, you'll see their events in your feed.

Q: What are verified relationships?
A: Verified relationships let you formally connect family members (like marking someone as your "sister" or "dad"). Both parties must confirm the relationship. This helps build your family tree and adds context to your connections.

Q: What are tag profiles?
A: Tag profiles let you tag people who don't have accounts yet - like young children, elderly relatives, or pets. You can create a profile for them and tag them in events. If they later join, they can claim their profile.

## Maps & Timeline
Q: How does the map view work?
A: The map view shows all events with locations on an interactive world map. You can see where your family has traveled and click on markers to view those events. It's a beautiful way to visualize your family's adventures.

Q: Can I see events from multiple family members on one map?
A: Yes! You can view all events you have access to on a single map, or filter by specific family members to see individual journeys.

Q: What is the timeline view?
A: The timeline view shows events organized chronologically, grouped by year. It's like a visual history of your family's memories over time.

## Subscription & Billing
Q: What's included in the free trial?
A: Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro features, including photo and video uploads, journey mapping, GPS extraction and AI Create. You can publish up to 5 events during the trial. After the trial you revert to the free plan unless you subscribe, which means you can still browse and comment but cannot create new events.

Q: How do I upgrade to Pro?
A: Go to Settings > Membership from your profile page. You can choose monthly ($12/mo) or annual ($9/mo billed yearly) billing. We also offer a one-time Lifetime option.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe, our secure payment partner. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes! You can cancel your subscription anytime. You'll keep Pro access until the end of your billing period. Your events and data are never deleted when you cancel.

Q: What happens to my events if I downgrade?
A: Your existing events stay exactly as they are, and you can always open your own events. You will not be able to create new events without an active subscription, and other people cannot open your events while your subscription is inactive, so resubscribing restores them.
-> Start your free trial: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> Contact us: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/contact
See also: features, pricing and about Our Family Socials.

# About Our Family Socials
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/about

Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network designed specifically for families to share life events, photos and memories together. Unlike public social media platforms, a new event goes to the family you have approved rather than to the open internet, and there are no algorithms deciding what you see.

## Why it exists
We built this platform because existing social networks were not designed for families. They are cluttered with ads, algorithms hide your posts, and your family photos end up mixed with everything else in an endless scroll. Our Family Socials gives families a dedicated space to preserve memories the way they deserve.

## Why we are different
- You choose the audience - a new event goes to the followers you have approved, and you can set any event to Close Family, a custom group such as "close family only", Private (just you) or Public (anyone with the link).
- No ads, ever - we will never sell your data or show you ads. Your family memories are not a product to be monetised.
- Rich event pages - photo galleries, detailed stories, multiple locations and GPS-tagged journey maps.
- Interactive maps and timeline - see your family's adventures on an interactive world map, and watch years of memories unfold chronologically.
- AI Create (beta) - let AI help draft an event description from your photos, then edit it yourself.
- Built for families - made by a family, for families. We use this app ourselves to stay connected with our own loved ones.

## How it works
1. Create an account - sign up for free at ourfamilysocials.com. You get a 30-day Pro trial automatically, with up to 5 published events during it.
2. Follow your family - send follow requests to family members. Once they accept, you see each other's events.
3. Share life events - create event pages with photos, stories, locations and dates. Choose the audience for each event.
4. Stay connected - view your family's events in the feed, on the map or in the timeline. Comment, like and engage.

## Who it is for
- Parents wanting to share kids' milestones with grandparents
- Extended families staying connected across distance
- Travellers documenting vacations with rich photo albums and maps
- Anyone tired of public social media and looking for a private alternative
- Families who value privacy and want to preserve memories without ads

## Pricing
Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.
Every new account starts with a 30-day Pro trial and no credit card is required. During the trial you can publish up to 5 events - only published events count, so drafts and deleted events are free. Pro and Lifetime remove the 5-event limit. If the trial ends and you have not subscribed you keep a free account for viewing, liking and commenting, but you cannot create new events until you subscribe.
-> Sign up free: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> View pricing details: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/pricing

# Private family sharing apps: the honest comparison
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/alternatives
Last updated: October 2026

If you are looking for a private place to share family photos and life events, these are the realistic options as of October 2026, what each is genuinely best at, and where Our Family Socials fits. Our Family Socials is our own product, so we have been explicit about the cases where you should pick something else. Competitor details are general and taken from each company's own website on the date above.

## Our Family Socials - best for whole-family events on a map and timeline
Our Family Socials is a private, ad-free social network for families. Its unit of content is an event - a trip, a wedding, a graduation, a Sunday dinner - with a written story, photo galleries, videos, dates and multiple locations. Events appear in a chronological feed from the family members you follow, on an interactive world map, and in a timeline by year. Relationships are confirmed by both people and build a family tree.
- Pick it if: you want the whole family's memories in one private, organised archive, with places and stories attached, and you are happy to pay so there are no ads.
- Pick something else if: you need free unlimited photo storage, printed photo books today, or native App Store and Google Play apps. Our Family Socials is a progressive web app, and photo books are still coming soon.
- Cost: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.

## FamilyAlbum - best for free unlimited storage and cheap prints
FamilyAlbum is an invite-only photo and video sharing app centred on a child's album. Its website advertises free unlimited uploads, automatic month-by-month organisation and 11 free prints a month per family member, plus photobooks and a Premium tier.
- Pick it if: cost and volume matter most, you want prints, and your focus is one child.
- Pick something else if: you want holidays, reunions and the whole extended family on a map and timeline rather than one album. See the full comparison.

## Tinybeans - best for a baby and toddler journal
Tinybeans is a private photo-sharing app for parents, organised as a dated journal of a young child and shared with an invited circle. It has native mobile apps, photo books, a paid Tinybeans+ tier and a large parenting content library.
- Pick it if: your main need is the day-by-day record of a baby or young child, from a polished mobile app.
- Pick something else if: you want one place that still works when the children are teenagers and the grandparents are posting too. See the full comparison.

## A private Facebook group - best if nobody will install anything new
A private group on Facebook is free, and most relatives already have an account. It is the lowest-friction option by a wide margin.
- Pick it if: cost is zero-tolerance and the family will not adopt a new service.
- Pick something else if: you do not want family memories on an advertising platform, or you are tired of an algorithm deciding which posts relatives see. See the full comparison.

## A private Instagram account (or Cluster) - best for instant, casual sharing
A private Instagram account restricts posts to approved followers, and apps like Cluster offer private group photo sharing. Both are free and fast.
- Pick it if: you want to post in seconds from an app you already use.
- Pick something else if: you want to find a specific trip years later, or keep the archive off an ad platform. See the full comparison.

## Shared cloud albums - best for cheap bulk storage
Apple Shared Albums and Google Photos shared albums let you invite specific people into an album using storage you already pay for.
- Pick it if: you just need a lot of photos somewhere private, cheaply.
- Pick something else if: you want the story, the places and the family conversation around the photos. See our guide to private photo sharing.

## Summary
- Free unlimited photo storage and prints
  - If this matters most: Cost and volume
  - Pick: FamilyAlbum
- A daily journal of a young child
  - If this matters most: One child, mobile-first
  - Pick: Tinybeans
- Nobody will install anything new
  - If this matters most: Zero friction
  - Pick: A private Facebook group
- Posting in seconds from an existing app
  - If this matters most: Speed and casualness
  - Pick: A private Instagram account
- A whole-family archive of events, places and stories, with no ads
  - If this matters most: Organisation and privacy
  - Pick: Our Family Socials
-> Start your free trial: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> See all features: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/features

# Our Family Socials vs private Facebook groups
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/facebook-groups
Last updated: October 2026

A private Facebook group is the default way most families share photos, and Our Family Socials is a purpose-built private family network. This page compares the two fairly so you can pick the right one. Facts about Facebook are general and taken from Meta's own documentation as of October 2026 - check facebook.com for current details.

## The short answer
Use a private Facebook group if every relative is already on Facebook, you want it to cost nothing, and you mainly want a chat-and-photos stream. Use Our Family Socials if you want family memories kept off an advertising platform, organised into event pages with maps and a timeline, and visible in the order they were posted.

## Where private Facebook groups are stronger
- No cost. Facebook groups are free to create and use. Our Family Socials charges for creating unlimited events.
- Everyone is already there. No relative has to sign up for a new service, and most already know how groups work.
- More general-purpose tools. Group chat, polls, RSVP-style events and a much larger ecosystem of features.
- Native iOS and Android apps with years of polish; Our Family Socials is a progressive web app you add to your home screen.

## Key differences
- Platform and business model
  - Private Facebook group: Runs on Meta's advertising platform, which is funded by ads and subject to Meta's policy changes.
  - Our Family Socials: A separate, subscription-funded platform. No advertising in the product and no selling of your data.
- Feed order
  - Private Facebook group: Facebook ranks what you see algorithmically, so posts in a group may not appear chronologically and can be missed.
  - Our Family Socials: Strictly chronological. Every event from the people you follow appears in the order it was shared.
- Organisation
  - Private Facebook group: Posts live in one long scroll. Finding last year's holiday album means scrolling or searching.
  - Our Family Socials: Events organised by date, location, person and category, with timeline and map views.
- Location features
  - Private Facebook group: Basic location tagging on a post.
  - Our Family Socials: Interactive world map, multi-stop journey maps, and automatic GPS extraction from photo metadata.
- Page depth
  - Private Facebook group: A post with a caption and an album.
  - Our Family Socials: An event page with a rich text story, galleries, videos, multiple locations, dates and tagged family members.
- Account requirements
  - Private Facebook group: Every member needs a Facebook account.
  - Our Family Socials: Sign-up with an email address, or view a single event through a private share link with no account at all.

## What it costs
A Facebook group costs nothing. Our Family Socials is free to view forever, and paid when you want to create unlimited events: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. # Our Family Socials vs Tinybeans
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/tinybeans
Last updated: October 2026

Tinybeans is a private photo-sharing app built around young children, and Our Family Socials is a private social network for a whole family's events. They overlap, but they are aimed at different jobs. Details about Tinybeans below are general and taken from tinybeans.com as of October 2026; check their site for current features and prices.

## The short answer
Choose Tinybeans if your main need is a private day-by-day journal of a baby or young child, shared with a small circle, from a polished mobile app. Choose Our Family Socials if you want one private space for the whole family's events - kids' milestones but also holidays, anniversaries, reunions and grandparents' birthdays - organised on a map and a timeline.

## Where Tinybeans is stronger
- Native iOS and Android apps, where Our Family Socials is a progressive web app you install from the browser.
- Purpose-built for the baby and toddler years, including milestone tracking and a daily journal format that fits that stage well.
- Printed photo books are available today. Photo books in Our Family Socials are advertised as coming soon and are not available yet.
- A large library of parenting articles published alongside the app.
- A much longer track record and a far bigger existing user base.

## Key differences
- Who the content is about
  - Tinybeans: Primarily a child: a private journal of a baby or young child shared with invited loved ones.
  - Our Family Socials: The whole family: kids' milestones, holidays, weddings, reunions, Sunday dinners, grandparents' birthdays.
- Unit of content
  - Tinybeans: Dated photo and video entries in a journal, organised by day and month.
  - Our Family Socials: Event pages: a trip or celebration with a story, galleries, videos, dates and several locations.
- Maps
  - Tinybeans: Not a focus of the product.
  - Our Family Socials: Interactive world map, multi-stop journey maps, and GPS extraction from photo metadata.
- Network shape
  - Tinybeans: An invited audience for your own journal.
  - Our Family Socials: A follow graph across the extended family, plus confirmed relationships and a family tree.
- Platform
  - Tinybeans: Native mobile apps plus a web view.
  - Our Family Socials: Progressive web app on phone, tablet and desktop; installable to the home screen.

Tinybeans offers a free tier and a paid Tinybeans+ subscription; see tinybeans.com for current pricing, which we deliberately do not quote here because it changes. Our Family Socials: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. # Our Family Socials vs FamilyAlbum
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/familyalbum
Last updated: October 2026

FamilyAlbum is a free, invite-only photo and video sharing app built around a child's album, and Our Family Socials is a private social network built around whole-family events. If you mainly need somewhere free to put a lot of photos, FamilyAlbum is hard to beat; if you want each trip told as a story on a map, this is where Our Family Socials fits. Details about FamilyAlbum are general and taken from family-album.com as of October 2026.

## The short answer
Choose FamilyAlbum if free unlimited photo and video storage, automatic month-by-month organisation and cheap prints are what you want. Choose Our Family Socials if you want rich event pages with written stories, an interactive map of everywhere your family has been, a timeline by year, and a follow graph across the extended family rather than one child's album.

## Where FamilyAlbum is stronger
- Free unlimited storage. FamilyAlbum advertises free, unlimited photo and video uploads on its website; Our Family Socials needs a paid plan to create unlimited events.
- Free monthly prints. FamilyAlbum advertises 11 free photo prints a month for each family member, plus photobooks. Our Family Socials does not print anything yet.
- Native iOS and Android apps. Our Family Socials is a progressive web app.
- Zero-effort organisation. Uploads are sorted into a month-by-month album automatically, which is less work than writing an event page.

## Key differences
- What it is built around
  - FamilyAlbum: An album of a child's photos and videos, shared with invited family, auto-sorted by month.
  - Our Family Socials: Events: a trip, celebration or milestone belonging to anyone in the family, with the story attached.
- Storytelling
  - FamilyAlbum: Comments and reactions on photos, with captions.
  - Our Family Socials: A rich text editor per event, so the context, route and detail live with the photos.
- Maps and places
  - FamilyAlbum: Not a focus of the product.
  - Our Family Socials: Interactive world map, multi-stop journey maps, automatic GPS extraction from photo metadata, and filters by place.
- Who is in it
  - FamilyAlbum: You invite viewers to your album.
  - Our Family Socials: Extended family follow each other, confirm real relationships, and get a shared family tree.
- Prints
  - FamilyAlbum: Prints and photobooks are a core, available part of the product.
  - Our Family Socials: Photo books are advertised as coming soon and are not available yet.
- Business model
  - FamilyAlbum: Free with a Premium tier and print sales; see their site for current terms.
  - Our Family Socials: Subscription-funded, no advertising in the product, no selling of your data.

## What it costs
FamilyAlbum's website advertises the core app as free with unlimited storage, alongside a Premium tier and paid prints - check family-album.com for current terms. Our Family Socials: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. # Our Family Socials vs a private Instagram account
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/private-instagram
Last updated: October 2026

Many families use a private ("finsta"-style) Instagram account, or a private group photo app such as Cluster, to share pictures with relatives only. Our Family Socials is a private family social network built for the same job. This page compares them fairly. Facts about Instagram are general, from Meta's own documentation as of October 2026 - see instagram.com for current details.

## The short answer
A private Instagram account is free, instant, and already installed on everyone's phone. Our Family Socials costs money to post but keeps family memories off an advertising platform and organises them into event pages, a map and a timeline you can still browse in ten years.

## Where a private Instagram account is stronger
- Free, and already on every phone. No relative needs a new account or a new app.
- Native apps, Stories, Reels and DMs - a much broader set of ways to share a moment.
- Excellent camera and editing tools built into the app.
- Instant. Posting takes seconds, where writing an event page takes a few minutes.

## Key differences
- What "private" means
  - Private Instagram account: Only approved followers see your posts, but the account still sits on Meta's advertising platform and is governed by its terms.
  - Our Family Socials: Per-event audience settings - Followers by default, down to Private or up to Public - on a separate, subscription-funded platform, with no advertising in the product and no data selling.
- Feed order
  - Private Instagram account: Algorithmically ranked and mixed with suggested content, so a family post can be missed.
  - Our Family Socials: Chronological, and only from the family members you follow.
- Organisation over years
  - Private Instagram account: A grid of individual posts. Finding one trip means scrolling back through everything.
  - Our Family Socials: Event pages grouped by date, place, person and category, with a map and a year-by-year timeline.
- Depth per memory
  - Private Instagram account: Caption plus up to a fixed number of photos per post.
  - Our Family Socials: A full event page: rich text story, galleries, videos, multiple locations and tagged people.
- Sharing outside the circle
  - Private Instagram account: Followers only, or you make the whole account public.
  - Our Family Socials: A private link can share one single event with someone who has no account, without exposing anything else.
- Relationships
  - Private Instagram account: A flat follower list.
  - Our Family Socials: Confirmed family relationships, tag profiles for relatives without accounts, and a family tree.

## What about Cluster?
Cluster is another well-known private group photo-sharing app in this category. We have deliberately not listed its current features or pricing here because we have not verified them recently - check cluster.co directly if you are considering it.

## What it costs
Instagram is free. Our Family Socials: Free plan $0/forever, Pro $9/month billed annually ($108/year) or $12/month billed monthly, and a one-time Lifetime plan at $294. Every new account gets a 30-day free trial of Pro, no credit card required.

# How to share kids' photos privately with family
URL: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/compare/how-to-share-photos-privately
Last updated: October 2026

If you do not want your children's photos on public social media but grandparents still want to see them, you have four realistic options: a shared cloud album, a private group chat, a private photo app, or a private family social network. This guide explains what each is good at and how to choose.

## What to look for
- Private by default - content should be invisible until you deliberately share it
- Audience control - choose exactly who sees each photo or album
- No ad targeting - your family photos should not be feeding an advertising profile
- Easy for grandparents - simple enough for relatives who are not comfortable with new apps
- Organised by occasion - so a trip stays together instead of dissolving into a camera roll
- Durable - you want to still be able to find this in ten years

## Option 1: a shared cloud album
Apple Shared Albums, Google Photos shared albums and similar features let you invite specific people to an album. They are free with the storage you already pay for, and almost everyone can open a link.
- Good for: bulk photos, zero extra cost, no new app for relatives.
- Weak at: writing the story, organising by occasion over years, and keeping everything in one place when half the family is on iPhone and half on Android.

## Option 2: a private group chat
WhatsApp, Signal or iMessage group chats are the lowest-friction option: everyone is already there and photos arrive instantly.
- Good for: immediacy and conversation.
- Weak at: archiving. Photos get compressed, scroll away, and are effectively unfindable a year later.

## Option 3: a private photo app for children
Apps like FamilyAlbum and Tinybeans are built for exactly this: a private, invite-only album of a baby or young child, with native mobile apps and printing options.
- Good for: the baby and toddler years, free or cheap storage, prints and photo books.
- Weak at: growing with the family. They are centred on a child rather than on holidays, reunions and the rest of the family's life. See our FamilyAlbum comparison and Tinybeans comparison.

## Option 4: a private family social network
A private family social network such as Our Family Socials gives you the social part - a feed, comments, likes, following - without the public part. Each memory becomes an event page with a story, a gallery, dates and locations; relatives follow each other; and each event carries an audience setting, from your approved followers down to just you, or Public if you want a link anyone can open.
- Good for: an ongoing, organised family record across all ages, with maps, a timeline and real context around the photos.
- Weak at: being free. Viewing is free forever, but creating unlimited events needs a paid plan, and relatives do need to create an account (or open a single-event private link).

## Getting grandparents on board
- Sign-up is just an email and password, and viewing accounts are free forever.
- Private share links let you send one event to someone who refuses to sign up for anything.
- It works on any device - phone, tablet or computer - through the browser, with no app store download.
- Email invitations mean you can add a relative directly rather than explaining how to search for you.

## How to choose
If you want the cheapest possible dump of photos, use a shared cloud album. If you want conversation, use a group chat. If your child is under three and you want prints, use a dedicated child photo app. If you want a private family record that still makes sense in a decade - organised by event, place and person - use a private family social network.
-> Try Our Family Socials free: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/login
-> See all alternatives: https://www.ourfamilysocials.com/alternatives
